chapter_outcomes: Describe and evaluate the psychology being investigated in Bandura et al. (aggression): social learning theory; aggression

Describe and evaluate the psychology being investigated in Fagen et al. (elephant learning): operant conditioning; reinforcement (positive, negative, primary and secondary); shaping; behavioural chaining
Describe and evaluate the psychology being investigated in Saavedra and Silverman (button phobia): evaluative learning; operant conditioning; classical conditioning; phobias

Understand the background, aim(s), procedure (including research methods, sample, experimental design, controls, question types, research technique, measured and manipulated variables), ethical issues, results (quantitative and qualitative findings and their representation), conclusion(s), and strengths and weaknesses of each core study
Describe and evaluate the methodology used in each core study

Consider how each study relates to psychological issues and debates: the application of psychology to everyday life, individual and situational explanations, nature versus nurture, the use of children in psychological research, the use of animals in psychological research
